question: Which sacred locations are reached at the mouth of Kubjikā?
premises: Kuśāvarta is named as a location.
The meeting occurs at the mouth of Kubjikā.
inference: One reaches Kuśāvarta and the confluence at the mouth of Kubjikā.
uncertainties: The exact syntactic role of daivate is unclear in this elliptical verse.
plain_english: At Kuśāvarta and the deity, having arrived and met at the mouth of Kubjikā...
